questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A system receives 552 kJ and delivers 331 kJ of useful energy. Calculate efficiency to 1 d.p.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A population of 25352 grows by 3% in one year. Estimate the numerical increase.
questions.hint: Increase = population × growth rate as a decimal.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A region has 5500 global hectares of biocapacity. If average ecological footprint is 2 gha per person, how many people could be supported at that footprint?
questions.hint: Supported population = total biocapacity ÷ footprint per person.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: For matrix A = [[3, 2], [5, 4]], find det(A).

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: Let A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]] and B = [[2, 0], [1, 5]]. Find the element in row 1, column 1 of AB.
questions.promptLatex: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{pmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\1&5\end{pmatrix}$. Find the $(1,1)$ element of $AB$.
questions.hint: Multiply row 1 of A by column 1 of B.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: An undirected graph has 7 edges. Four of its five vertices have degrees 3, 3, 2 and 2. Find the degree of the fifth vertex.
questions.hint: The sum of the vertex degrees equals twice the number of edges.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: A connected graph has 8 vertices and is a tree. How many edges does it have?
questions.hint: A tree with n vertices has n−1 edges.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A spacecraft moves at 0.60c relative to Earth. Calculate its Lorentz factor γ.
questions.promptLatex: A spacecraft moves at $0.60c$ relative to Earth. Calculate its Lorentz factor $\gamma$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A rod has proper length 10.0 m and moves parallel to its length at 0.60c. Find its measured length in the laboratory frame in m.
questions.promptLatex: A rod has proper length $10.0\,\mathrm{m}$ and moves parallel to its length at $0.60c$. Find its measured length in the laboratory frame.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A clock moving at 0.60c measures a proper time interval of 4.0 μs. Find the interval measured in the laboratory frame in μs.
questions.promptLatex: A clock moving at $0.60c$ measures a proper time interval of $4.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Find the interval measured in the laboratory frame.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: In frame S, an object moves at 0.80c. An observer moves in the same direction at 0.50c. Using relativistic velocity transformation, find the object speed measured by the observer as a fraction of c.
questions.promptLatex: In frame $S$, an object moves at $0.80c$. An observer moves in the same direction at $0.50c$. Find the object speed measured by the observer as a fraction of $c$.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: For a reaction, ΔH° = −50.0 kJ mol⁻¹ and ΔS° = −100 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ at 298 K. Calculate ΔG° in kJ mol⁻¹.
questions.promptLatex: For a reaction, $\Delta H^\circ=-50.0\,\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ and $\Delta S^\circ=-100\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$ at $298\,\mathrm{K}$. Calculate $\Delta G^\circ$ in $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
questions.hint: $\Delta G=\Delta H-T\Delta S$; convert J to kJ.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A reaction has ΔH° = +40.0 kJ mol⁻¹ and ΔS° = +100 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. At what temperature in K does ΔG° become zero?
questions.promptLatex: A reaction has $\Delta H^\circ=+40.0\,\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ and $\Delta S^\circ=+100\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$. At what temperature does $\Delta G^\circ=0$?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: The total standard entropy of the products is 450 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ and that of the reactants is 330 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Find ΔS° in J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
questions.promptLatex: The total standard entropy of the products is $450\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$ and that of the reactants is $330\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$. Find $\Delta S^\circ$.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: At constant pressure and temperature, which sign of ΔG indicates a thermodynamically spontaneous change?
options: The sign of ΔG is irrelevant
questions.promptLatex: At constant pressure and temperature, which sign of $\Delta G$ indicates a thermodynamically spontaneous change?
questions.hint: Spontaneous change proceeds in the direction that lowers Gibbs energy.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which observation is evidence supporting the endosymbiotic origin of mitochondria?
options: Mitochondria are enclosed by a single membrane
Mitochondria contain circular DNA and 70S ribosomes
Mitochondria are produced by the Golgi apparatus
questions.hint: Look for features shared with prokaryotes.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which pair of components is present in all viruses?
options: Genetic material and a protein capsid
questions.hint: Viruses may differ in genome type and envelope, but all package genetic material.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: On a cladogram, what does a node represent?
questions.hint: A branch point represents divergence from an ancestral lineage.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: In many eukaryotic genes, increased methylation of promoter DNA is most directly associated with what change?
questions.hint: Promoter methylation commonly reduces access of transcription machinery.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A firm chooses a satisfactory level of profit rather than the maximum possible profit. Which concept best describes this behaviour?
questions.hint: The firm accepts an outcome that is good enough rather than optimal.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Which factor is most directly associated with bounded rationality?
options: Limited information, time and cognitive capacity
questions.hint: Decision-makers face practical limits when processing information.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A business deliberately accepts lower short-run profit to improve worker welfare and reduce environmental damage. This most directly challenges which assumption?
questions.hint: The firm is pursuing stakeholder objectives alongside profit.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Which statement best explains why a consumer may not maximize utility in practice?
options: Utility can always be measured exactly
Consumers always know every available price
Consumers may have incomplete information and use rules of thumb
questions.hint: Behavioural limitations can prevent fully optimizing choices.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: Which principle supports taking protective action when there is a plausible risk of serious environmental harm even if scientific certainty is incomplete?
questions.hint: It addresses uncertainty by acting before harm is fully proven.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: Which principle states that the party responsible for environmental damage should bear the cost of preventing or remedying that damage?
questions.hint: The name of the principle describes who should pay.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: In ecological economics, the economy is best described as what?
options: A subsystem of the larger biosphere and social-ecological system
A closed system with no material inputs
questions.hint: Ecological economics embeds economic activity within Earth systems.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: The claim that a species has value regardless of any benefit it provides to humans refers to which type of value?
questions.hint: This value exists independently of usefulness to people.
